import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.datasets import load_wine
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

churn = pd.read_csv("churn.csv")
behaviour = ["orders", "total_spent", "avg_order_value", "days_since_last_order",
             "tenure_days", "mobile_share"]

segments = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), KMeans(n_clusters=4, n_init=10, random_state=42))
labels = segments.fit_predict(churn[behaviour])

churn_by_cluster = churn.groupby(labels)["churned"].mean()
highest_rate = churn_by_cluster.max()

X_wine, y_wine = load_wine(return_X_y=True)
pca = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), PCA(n_components=2)).fit(X_wine)
wine_var_2 = pca[-1].explained_variance_ratio_.sum()
print(churn_by_cluster.round(2).to_dict(), round(wine_var_2, 3))
